meta.title: Subagent Delegation Policy
meta.description: Default subagents to a low-cost route, with per-role route and sandbox tiers; an explicit provider/model on the delegation call still wins.

card.notice: Saving writes immediately; the debug switch applies instantly. Pin-route changes affect later delegations but need a fresh session, and the new route must sit in the "allow agents to pick subagent models" allowlist.

card.debugHelp: Writes %TEMP%\subagent-model-pin.log (override with the SUBAGENT_MODEL_PIN_LOG env var)
card.resetConfirm: Clear every UI override of provider / model / effort / debug and return to the values in cordis.patch.yml?
card.conflict: The config changed elsewhere; review and retry.
card.failed: Save failed; refreshed to the latest values, please retry.
